On August 30, 2017, it was announced that Radke was one of 18 competitors on """", the 35th season of the U.S. version of ""Survivor"". She was part of the Levu (Heroes) tribe and was the first person voted out of the game. Radke is married to former Stanford University and Olympic swim coach Ross Gerry. Together, they reside in Excelsior, Minnesota, and have two children.
